records.text: 19th Special Forces Group (Airborne) worked with Romanian Special Operations Forces Command

appearances.snippet: Particularly, the U.S. Army's 19 Special Forces Airborne routinely deploy, of all places, to Romania to conduct unconventional warfare. They train with Romanian special operations force, working alongside NATO allies.
